title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context (pp. 31-33): Grothendieck builds the central extension 1 → Z → Gl(2,Z)~ → Gl(2,Z) → 1, with central generator l'_0 = k(1). Its index-2 subgroup Sl(2,Z)~ = <ρ̃, σ̃ | ρ̃^3 σ̃^2 central> is the braid group B_3. In the generators ε̃_0 = σ̃ρ̃ and ε̃_1 = ρ̃σ̃ it has the single relation ε̃_0 ε̃_1 ε̃_0 = ε̃_1 ε̃_0 ε̃_1. Gl(2,Z)~ is obtained by adjoining an involution r̃_0 = τ̃' that inverts ρ̃ and σ̃.

(1) Top of page. Conjugation by ρ̃^3 = ω̃_0^{-1} sends τ̃'_∞ to ω̃_0^{-1} τ̃'_∞ ω̃_0. Since τ̃' inverts ω̃_0 and ω̃_0^2 = l'_0, this equals l'_0^{-1} τ̃'_∞.
- So the orbit ρ̃^n(τ̃'_∞), n ∈ Z, cycles through lifts of τ'_∞, τ'_0, τ'_1 (since ρτ'_iρ^{-1} = τ'_{i+1}).
- Each full turn of three steps shifts the lift by the central element l'_0^{-1}.
- Every lift of a τ'_i is automatically an involution, because τ̃ inverts l'_0.
- Hence the bi-infinite sequence is injective and runs through the entire preimage of {τ'_∞, τ'_0, τ'_1}. It is a Z-indexed linear ordering of the lifted reflections. The same holds for the τ_i.

(2) Rest of page: an explicit faithful model of Gl(2,Z)~ inside Aut(F_2), F_2 = <ũ, ṽ>. Notation ũ(ṽ) means ũṽũ^{-1}. The formulas are:
- r̃_0 swaps u and v.
- r̃_∞: u ↦ u^{-1}, v ↦ u v u^{-1}.
- r̃_1: u ↦ u^{-1}, v ↦ u v.
- ρ̃: u ↦ v^{-1}, v ↦ v u.
- σ̃: u ↦ u v u^{-1}, v ↦ u^{-1}.
- ε̃_0: u ↦ u, v ↦ v u^{-1}.
- ε̃_1: u ↦ u v, v ↦ v.

I verified all of these with the composition convention (φψ)(x) = φ(ψ(x)):
- ε̃_0 ε̃_1 ε̃_0 = ε̃_1 ε̃_0 ε̃_1 = σ̃ (u ↦ uvu^{-1}, v ↦ u^{-1}).
- ρ̃ = ε̃_0^{-1} ε̃_1^{-1}; σ̃ρ̃ = ε̃_0; ρ̃σ̃ = ε̃_1.
- r̃_0^2 = r̃_1^2 = r̃_∞^2 = 1.
- r̃_0 ε̃_0 r̃_0 = ε̃_1^{-1}.
- r̃_1 = r̃_0 ρ̃ and r̃_∞ = σ̃ r̃_0.
- r̃_∞ r̃_1 = ε̃_0.

Modern reading: these are Nielsen automorphisms. Sl(2,Z)~ ≅ B_3 ≅ Mod(Σ_{1,1}, ∂) acts on π_1 = F_2 and fixes the boundary commutator c = [u,v]. Gl(2,Z)~ is the group of automorphisms sending c to c^{±1}; for example r̃_0 sends c to c^{-1}. The centre acts by conjugation by a power of c.

Purpose: a 'formulaire' for the genus-one / three-point level of the Teichmüller tower. It identifies the (extended) mapping class group of M_{1,1} with tangential base point, and of M_{0,3}-type objects, with Gl(2,Z)~. This is needed to write down the action on F_2, and on its profinite completion, which ĜT-type symmetries must respect.
errors: No mathematical errors found; all displayed automorphism formulas are mutually consistent with the relations of p.31.
Mild notational ambiguity: 'u(v)' denotes inner conjugation uvu^{-1}, not a product.
On p.33 the symbol l'_0 is reused for ε_0 at matrix level, whereas on p.31-32 it is the central generator k(1). This is a notational clash across pages, not an error here.

ideas.what: Central Z-extension of GL(2,Z) whose orientation-preserving part is B_3, presented by braid generators ε̃_0, ε̃_1 and an involution r̃_0 inverting them up to swap
ideas.modern_name: B_3 ≅ Sl(2,Z)~ (universal-type central extension of SL(2,Z) / of PSL(2,Z)); extended braid group B_3 ⋊ Z/2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Artin (B_3), classical; extended mapping class group folklore
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses M_{1,1}, M_{0,4} and the Teichmüller tower but not these explicit presentations

ideas.what: Explicit faithful action of the extension on F_2 = π_1 of the once-bordered torus by Nielsen automorphisms preserving the commutator up to inversion
ideas.modern_name: Mod(Σ_{1,1},∂) ≅ B_3 ⊂ Aut(F_2), stabiliser of [u,v]; Nielsen's theorem

ideas.what: Orbit of a lifted reflection under conjugation by the order-6-mod-centre element ρ̃ gives a Z-indexed enumeration of all lifts of the three reflections τ'_i
ideas.modern_name: Lifting of the triangle reflections to the central extension (torsor of lifts under the centre)

deep.surprise_reason: Careful, correct bookkeeping of classical facts: B_3 as a central extension of SL(2,Z), its Nielsen action on F_2, and the lifts of reflections. This is a formula sheet for the Teichmüller tower; nothing beyond the standard literature.
transcription_corrections: 'r̃_∞(ṽ) = ũ(ṽ)' and 'σ̃(ũ) = ũ(ṽ)': here ũ(ṽ) means the inner conjugate ũṽũ^{-1} (Grothendieck's notation), which the formulas confirm.
'parcourt injectivement l'un des relevés' is more plausibly 'l'ens[emble] des relevés'. The orbit ρ̃^n(τ̃'_∞) indeed exhausts all lifts of {τ'_∞, τ'_0, τ'_1}.
The crossed-out symbol after 'ρ̃^3(τ̃'_∞) =' appears to be an aborted τ̃ with an index, before he rewrote it as ω̃_0^{-1}(τ̃'_∞).
